placement.claim: A Git-backed review-artifact contract adjacent to proposal packets is a plausible initial owner, but evidence has not resolved whether the durable contract belongs to proposal review or to a shared cross-phase review substrate.

reopening_conditions: Dogfooding shows that proposal packet references alone can preserve revision identity, finding provenance, applicability, and supersession without a distinct review-artifact contract.
An implementation-review consumer establishes shared lifecycle requirements that make a proposal-local owner incorrect.
Observed review remediation requires transactional or runtime semantics that Git-backed artifacts cannot provide.
A concrete consumer shows that selection, findings, synthesis, and resolution require different durable owners.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Adaptive coordination needs a durable way to bind findings and synthesis to an exact subject revision and preserve later applicability; this semantic dependency does not impose a mandatory delivery order.
